I changed mine up a bit tonight, and holy shit they peel amazingly!

* Cover in cold water with about a half-inch above the eggs (uncovered) * Put enough water in the fridge to cover the eggs to cool them down later on (ie - don't ice bath, just "cool bath" them) * Bring to a decent boil where the water is bubbling all over, but not too aggressive of a boil * Cover and take off the heat for ~16:30 * Put the eggs in the fridge water for 12 minutes and put them in the fridge * dry them off and put into other containers and put them in the fridge

I used to seriously ice bath the eggs when they came out, but doing a less extreme cooling process seemed to make them peel so easily! I think maybe you shouldn't go too cold after taking them out of the pot. I used to use a ton of ice and try to cool them down as quick as possible. It seems like a gradual cool helps the peeling process.

Then again, this could just be luck...but 4 eggs later that peeled brilliantly, I think I might be onto something.
